condition: If set_output(transform='pandas') is set on a Pipeline or ColumnTransformer, it also applies to a nested OneHotEncoder that outputs sparse data, so you get a ValueError even when a later step such as TruncatedSVD would have made the final output dense.
workaround: Pass sparse_output=False to OneHotEncoder. Alternatively, call set_output on each step separately (OneHotEncoder().set_output(transform='default')) and don't call it on the outer Pipeline or ColumnTransformer.
